releases.title: Capture, edit, and a much lighter iLand

notes.text: Screenshot markup — after a capture a preview drops out of the notch. Click it to add arrows, boxes or freehand strokes, crop the shot, then copy or save it.
Screen recording editor — record the full screen or just an area, then trim the start and end, crop the frame, and copy it as MP4 or save it.
Global keyboard shortcuts for Area Screenshot, Screen Recording and Color Picker — assign them in Settings → Shortcuts.
Right-click any shot in the Tray history to edit, copy or delete it, with select-all for quick clean-ups.
Big energy win — iLand now uses a small fraction of the CPU it used to while music is playing.
Swipe between the iLand and Tray tabs — they slide across instead of snapping.
Large and XL sizes get proportionally rounder bottom corners, and the Tray cards now line up with the widgets above them.
The previous-track button now animates in the direction it actually moves.
